summary: Read-only verification of WS-BUILD-CONNECT-GPU surface. All 10 in-scope checks passed. Home 200, deliverables 200 with snapshot_commit + BUILD_STRATEGY.md/REUSE_ASSESSMENT.md items. Login gate renders with password-type owner-token-input + owner-token-submit; tile grid hidden pre-login. Bad token 'wrong-token-abc' persists to localStorage.owner_token (frontend-only, no verify call). Correct token from /app/backend/.owner_credentials unlocks two-pane layout: LEFT pane pills (Work/Build/3rd Party Apps/Admin), TRUST CENTER (Manage Rules/Data Shield/Reasoning Shield/Access Shield), REGISTRY (Data Estate/Models/Compute/Connect). RIGHT pane shows REGISTRY eyebrow + serif 'Connect · GPU' title + description. tile-connect click renders form with all 7 fields (host_name/username/password[type=password]/public_ip/private_ip/os/deploy_date) + submit + signout buttons. Backend curl: no auth -> 401 'owner bearer token required'; wrong bearer -> 403 'owner bearer token rejected'; correct bearer + {} -> 422 with pydantic missing-field details. Signout clears localStorage.owner_token and returns to login card. Form NOT submitted per instructions.

issues: Deploy date uses browser default date picker (input type=date). No spec requirement for shadcn calendar here, so noted as informational only.
